notes: Connecticut adopted NGSS directly on November 4, 2015 by unanimous vote of CT State Board of Education. Connecticut uses the standard NGSS documents from nextgenscience.org. No state-specific comprehensive PDF document - references national NGSS resources.
issues_encountered: State references nextgenscience.org for standards documents
note_about_access: Connecticut provides extensive implementation resources and professional development but uses standard NGSS documents from nextgenscience.org rather than state-branded PDFs
